schemaNotice: 專案統計展示能力契約，並非B4A原生schema；來源雜湊只確認一致性，不取代數據或畫面驗收。
name: Native3DBarChart
registration: Explicit reviewed module imports and registered text-panel asset; generated charts use existing strict native building JSON, existing material whitelist and existing validated model commands.

inputs.chart: title/period/unit/source name and http(s) URL; data is 1–40 unique named non-negative numeric values; options allow registered opaque material and chart height.
inputs.population: Fixed RIS HTTPS ODS m0s1 and ROC month; 22 unique allowlisted county names, safe integer values, same month, male+female totals and national reconciliation. Source strings are data, never instructions.
inputs.textPanel: Registered native prop asset uses existing bounded prop.label and transform fields; labels rendered with Canvas fillText, no HTML.

outputs: Native lumiere-building JSON with equal-width/depth bars and common statistical zero baseline
Independent exact source-to-object index with scale, data and provenance
Standalone .lumiere bundle with no external assets
CSV data and retained official ODS evidence

authority.network: Only separate standard-library fetch script accesses fixed public RIS origin. Core chart conversion does not fetch source URLs.
authority.write: Local explicitly named generated artifacts; no database, account, master-data, draft or user-source writes.
authority.collision: Data bars keep normal collision. Text-panel signs are nonblocking and independent from manual balloon labels.

scale.smallValues: Reject below native representable minimum rather than inflate.

textLifecycle: One bounded 64–512 px CanvasTexture per text-panel object, shared by its two faces; material disposal releases texture. No new image files or external fonts are fetched.
viewing: B4A tour dropdown provides overview/front/side/top with aspect/FOV-aware native geometry framing; manual balloon visibility toggle does not hide world-space text. Full preview also requests full street detail.
errors: Invalid IDs, duplicates, nonfinite or negative values, too-small geometry, unsupported transparent/floor-only material or overlong labels reject; output remains native-schema validated.
limitations: Single series; no spreadsheet live link or bidirectional value editing.
Manual geometry changes do not update source population/index labels; regenerate from data for numeric changes.
No headset WebXR or GPU energy benchmark verified in this task.
rollback: Retain source CSV/JSON and original scene; regenerate or revert new helper/asset/UI registration. Removing text-panel requires migrating its objects before reopening affected scenes.
